name: Belt
description: A belt and its buckle, the buckle a plain open square.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 38%; width: 100%; height: 24%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 24%; top: 26%; width: 34%; height: 48%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%, 0% 0%, 26.0% 22.0%, 26.0% 78.0%, 74.0% 78.0%, 74.0% 22.0%, 26.0% 22.0%); clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%, 0% 0%, 26.0% 22.0%, 26.0% 78.0%, 74.0% 78.0%, 74.0% 22.0%, 26.0% 22.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
